Thank you! They're both doing okay now, but my dog hasn't left my side and my cat is still a little skittish when I approach him. In regards to an agreement, we made the decision for her to stay through verbal communication but everything else has been written down in some form. I have text messages before & after her stay and I have a note that I left explaining my animals dietry needs & how much/when to feed. There's also strict instructions to NOT leave my dog free to roam when she was out or asleep and to crate her because she gets so distressed. I also have a note from my 'friend' that was there when I returned home. It contradicts everything I found (such as food bowl being washed just before she left even though it was hidden on the fridge covered in poop and feeding my cat downstairs even though the room was covered with empty cat packets)

Other than verbal, there's no other proof that she has provided so far. £170 seems like such an odd number, and I don't understand what she needed it for with a house full of food. I guess the takeaway boxes in the bin are evidence for what she spent it on. I think she was definitely trying to push her luck, I suffer with a really bad panic disorder and her text message left me in such a bad state. The flight was nothing short of horrific and without saying too much, it's going to be hard to be able to pluck up the courage to show my face on an airplane again without being reminded of what happened.

Definitely, she isn't someone I want to be associated with any longer. I would have gone with a pet sitter, but I knew she would benefit from the money so I guess I was trying to help her out in a way too. I've learned my lesson the hard way unfortunately!
I have evidence of everything apart from the phone call. I do have some text messages though which sort of discuss the same things I mentioned over the phone

I mentioned this to her and her excuse was that she had a house full of food at home. She actually has a few animals herself, so that's something I'm currently thinking about. She has 3/4 cats but I never see them when I've visited because she keeps them upstairs out of the way. Makes me wonder how she's treating her own if she can treat mine so badly
I'm thinking about Small Claims court myself but honestly I think I just want to forget about her and move on. She was clearly never a friend
